mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, st.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, c.grade, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS fullName, st.status, sg.relationship, sg.is_primary AS primaryGuardian FROM student_guardian sg JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = g.user_id JOIN student st ON st.id = sg.student_id AND st.school_id = gu.school_id JOIN school s ON s.id = st.school_id JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id WHERE sg.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND sg.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sg.is_primary DESC, st.full_name

SELECT st.id, st.school_id, c.grade, st.status FROM student st JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = st.id JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = g.user_id AND gu.school_id = st.school_id WHERE st.id = #{studentId} AND sg.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND sg.is_active = TRUE

SELECT st.id, st.school_id, c.grade, st.status FROM student st JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = st.id JOIN guardian g ON g.id = sg.guardian_id JOIN sys_user gu ON gu.id = g.user_id AND gu.school_id = st.school_id WHERE st.id = #{studentId} AND sg.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND sg.is_active = TRUE FOR UPDATE
SELECT st.id, st.school_id, c.grade, st.status FROM student st JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id WHERE st.id = #{studentId}
SELECT st.id, st.school_id, c.grade, st.status FROM student st JOIN school_class c ON c.id = st.class_id WHERE st.id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE

mapper.sql: o.id, o.school_id, c.target_grade_min, c.target_grade_max, o.week_day, o.start_time, o.end_time, o.start_date, o.end_date, o.enrollment_start, o.enrollment_end, o.capacity, o.enrolled_count, o.status, c.status AS course_status, term.status AS term_status, plan.status AS plan_status

SELECT FROM course_offering o JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id WHERE o.id = #{offeringId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT MIN(TIMESTAMP(session_date, start_time)) FROM lesson_session WHERE offering_id = #{offeringId} AND status != 'CANCELED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e JOIN course_offering existing ON existing.id = e.offering_id JOIN course_offering candidate ON candidate.id = #{offeringId} WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.status = 'ENROLLED' AND e.offering_id != #{offeringId} AND existing.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'FINISHED') AND ( /* Both offerings have real effective sessions: compare the adjusted lesson_session dates/times directly. */ EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session existing_session JOIN lesson_session candidate_session ON candidate_session.offering_id = candidate.id AND candidate_session.status != 'CANCELED' AND candidate_session.session_date = existing_session.session_date AND candidate_session.start_time < existing_session.end_time AND candidate_session.end_time > existing_session.start_time WHERE existing_session.offering_id = existing.id AND existing_session.status != 'CANCELED' ) /* A target offering with no generated effective session still protects its template against an existing actual session. */ OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session candidate_session WHERE candidate_session.offering_id = candidate.id AND candidate_session.status != 'CANCELED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session existing_session WHERE existing_session.offering_id = existing.id AND existing_session.status != 'CANCELED' AND candidate.week_day = WEEKDAY(existing_session.session_date) + 1 AND candidate.start_date <= existing_session.session_date AND candidate.end_date >= existing_session.session_date AND candidate.start_time < existing_session.end_time AND candidate.end_time > existing_session.start_time ) ) /* Conversely, protect an existing no-session template against a real (including rescheduled) target lesson. */ OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session existing_session WHERE existing_session.offering_id = existing.id AND existing_session.status != 'CANCELED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session candidate_session WHERE candidate_session.offering_id = candidate.id AND candidate_session.status != 'CANCELED' AND existing.week_day = WEEKDAY(candidate_session.session_date) + 1 AND existing.start_date <= candidate_session.session_date AND existing.end_date >= candidate_session.session_date AND existing.start_time < candidate_session.end_time AND existing.end_time > candidate_session.start_time ) ) /* Only when neither offering has an effective session may the recurring offering templates decide the conflict. */ OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session existing_session WHERE existing_session.offering_id = existing.id AND existing_session.status != 'CANCELED' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lesson_session candidate_session WHERE candidate_session.offering_id = candidate.id AND candidate_session.status != 'CANCELED' ) AND existing.week_day = candidate.week_day AND existing.start_date <= candidate.end_date AND existing.end_date >= candidate.start_date AND existing.start_time < candidate.end_time AND existing.end_time > candidate.start_time ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE course_offering SET enrolled_count = enrolled_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{offeringId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND enrolled_count < capacity
UPDATE course_offering SET enrolled_count = enrolled_count - 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{offeringId} AND enrolled_count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (school_id, offering_id, student_id, guardian_id) VALUES (#{schoolId}, #{offeringId}, #{studentId}, #{guardianId})
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollment SET guardian_id = #{guardianId}, status = 'ENROLLED', enrolled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), canceled_at = NULL, canceled_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELED'
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.offering_id, e.student_id, e.status FROM enrollment e JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = e.student_id AND sg.guardian_id = e.guardian_id AND sg.is_active = TRUE WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND e.school_id = ( SELECT u.school_id FROM guardian g JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE g.id = #{guardianId} )

SELECT e.id, e.offering_id, e.student_id, e.status FROM enrollment e JOIN student_guardian sg ON sg.student_id = e.student_id AND sg.guardian_id = e.guardian_id AND sg.is_active = TRUE WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND e.school_id = ( SELECT u.school_id FROM guardian g JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE g.id = #{guardianId} ) FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: e.id, e.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, e.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, o.term, c.course_name AS courseName, o.teacher_id AS teacherId, t.full_name AS teacherName, o.week_day AS weekDay, o.start_time AS startTime, o.end_time AS endTime, e.student_id AS studentId, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.full_name AS studentName, st.class_id AS classId, sc.class_name AS className, e.guardian_id AS guardianId, g.full_name AS guardianName, e.status, e.enrolled_at AS enrolledAt, e.canceled_at AS canceledAt, e.canceled_by AS canceledBy, canceler.display_name AS canceledByName
mapper.select: SELECT FROM enrollment e JOIN school s ON s.id = e.school_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = e.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id JOIN student st ON st.id = e.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN guardian g ON g.id = e.guardian_id LEFT JOIN sys_user canceler ON canceler.id = e.canceled_by WHERE e.offering_id = #{offeringId} AND e.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT FROM enrollment e JOIN school s ON s.id = e.school_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = e.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id JOIN student st ON st.id = e.student_id JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = st.class_id LEFT JOIN guardian g ON g.id = e.guardian_id
JOIN student_guardian current_binding ON current_binding.student_id = e.student_id AND current_binding.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND current_binding.is_active = TRUE
LEFT JOIN sys_user canceler ON canceler.id = e.canceled_by
e.school_id = #{schoolId} AND o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND current_binding.guardian_id = #{guardianId} AND e.student_id = #{studentId}
ORDER BY e.enrolled_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT o.id, o.school_id AS schoolId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, o.term, o.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.category, c.target_grade_min AS targetGradeMin, c.target_grade_max AS targetGradeMax, t.full_name AS teacherName, o.week_day AS weekDay, o.start_time AS startTime, o.end_time AS endTime, o.start_date AS startDate, o.end_date AS endDate, o.enrollment_start AS enrollmentStart, o.enrollment_end AS enrollmentEnd, o.capacity, o.enrolled_count AS enrolledCount, o.classroom, o.status FROM course_offering o JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id WHERE o.school_id = #{schoolId} AND o.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.category, c.course_name, o.week_day, o.start_time

SELECT a.id, a.student_id AS studentId, c.course_name AS courseName, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, t.full_name AS teacherName, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.end_time AS endTime, a.status, a.remark, a.recorded_at AS recordedAt FROM attendance a JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = a.session_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = a.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY ls.session_date DESC, ls.start_time DESC

SELECT ls.id, ls.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, c.course_name AS courseName, t.full_name AS teacherName, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.end_time AS endTime, ls.classroom, ls.status, lr.status AS leaveStatus FROM lesson_session ls JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = ls.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id JOIN enrollment e ON e.offering_id = ls.offering_id AND e.student_id = #{studentId} LEFT JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.session_id = ls.id AND lr.student_id = #{studentId} AND lr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') WHERE e.enrolled_at <= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time) AND (e.canceled_at IS NULL OR e.canceled_at >= TIMESTAMP(ls.session_date, ls.start_time)) ORDER BY ls.session_date, ls.start_time, ls.id

SELECT a.id, a.student_id AS studentId, c.course_name AS courseName, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, t.full_name AS teacherName, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS startTime, ls.end_time AS endTime, a.status, a.remark, a.recorded_at AS recordedAt FROM attendance a JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = a.session_id JOIN course_offering o ON o.id = a.offering_id JOIN course c ON c.id = o.course_id JOIN teacher t ON t.id = o.teacher_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND ls.session_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY ls.session_date DESC, ls.start_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(a.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS presentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'LEAVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount, COALESCE(ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.id), 0), 1 ), 0) AS attendanceRate FROM attendance a JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.id = a.session_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND ls.session_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT school_class.class_name AS className, student.student_no AS studentNo, student.full_name AS studentName, course.course_name AS courseName, offering.offering_code AS offeringCode, teacher.full_name AS teacherName, enrollment.status, enrollment.enrolled_at AS enrolledAt FROM enrollment JOIN student ON student.id = enrollment.student_id JOIN school_class ON school_class.id = student.class_id JOIN course_offering offering ON offering.id = enrollment.offering_id JOIN course ON course.id = offering.course_id JOIN teacher ON teacher.id = offering.teacher_id WHERE student.class_id = #{classId} AND enrollment.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY student.student_no, course.course_name, offering.offering_code
